theorems.name: Submission.mcs_trace_normal_part_eq_neg_inner
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (pr : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)) (X Y : Euclid P → Euclid P) (x : Euclid P), Q ≤ S → pr x = S.starProjection → DifferentiableAt ℝ pr x → DifferentiableAt ℝ X x → Y =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => X y - pr y (X y)) → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (Q.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ Y x).toLinearMap) = -inner ℝ (X x) (∑ j : Fin P, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ pr x (Q.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) (Q.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))
